title: Email Outreach CRM Integration
summary: Complete handoff for integrating B2B Lead Discovery + Cold Email Outreach into tdgames_billing CRM module. Two main flows: (1) Lead Discovery — input company name + domain → web scraping + Google CSE + SalesQL enrichment → enriched contacts with 3-tier ranking. Key Python functions: scrape_general_emails(), search_linkedin_targets(), salesql_enrich(), get_title_tier() from email_discovery_bot.py. (2) Email Outreach — 3-email sequence via Gmail API (initial → followup1 Day3 → followup2 Day7), rate limiting 30/day, sender Tony Dang (toan.dang@tdgamestudio.com). Architecture: React SPA (frontend) + FastAPI on VPS port 8401 (email sending + lead discovery) + Supabase (data storage). 553 contacts / 131 studios enriched. Supabase tables: crm_outreach_leads, crm_email_log, crm_email_templates. Source code at e:/TDC_App/TDGAMES_App/Client_Data/. API Keys in .env (SalesQL, Google CSE). Gmail OAuth token at credentials/gmail_token.json.
